purpose: Combine a host-defined metric, explicit comparison and ordered underlying chart data.
behaviorProvider: Shared Card, AreaChart/BarChart, MiniBarChart and ChartDataTable.

component: Ignore nonfinite delta. Determine direction from its sign, while favorable/unfavorable color and hidden text require explicit trendIsPositive. Zero and omitted desirability remain neutral.
Reject the plotted dataset when any value is nonfinite, or when compact values are negative. Show a textual unavailable message and suppress latest/chart content for invalid data.
Use token-backed default heights for compact/full variants; finite explicit heights are clamped to the minimum chart height.
host: Supply metric as the intended aggregation and data oldest-to-newest. The card neither derives metric from data nor sorts records; latest is the final supplied record.
Choose units, time period, comparison baseline and desirability explicitly. The component does not validate that the summary metric is finite or agrees with the records.

Use AreaChart or BarChart with legend hidden and exact data enabled; full bars use datum colors when provided. Compact uses MiniBarChart with a descriptive interval/latest label and its own exact data table.
Apply valueFormatter to numeric summary, latest values and full chart ticks/tooltips. Keep exact data table values unformatted; summary title preserves localized numeric detail.
For valid empty compact data show No data for this period; full charts delegate empty rendering to their container. No latest interval renders for empty data.
Choose units, time period, comparison baseline and desirability explicitly. The component does not validate that the summary metric is finite or agrees with the records.
Consume data-viz group tokens for this family; nested shared components retain their declared ownership. Keep theme/mode changes in token mappings rather than branching behavioral code.

limitations: No fetching, retry, loading state or aggregation logic is supplied by this card.
Compact charts are noninteractive mini bars; detailed exact values live in the disclosure.
